Home.title: OpenInvites
Home.tagline: An open source, self-hostable service for event invitations.

verifyEmail.subject: Verify your email for OpenInvites
verifyEmail.body:
Hi {name},

Open the link below to confirm this is your email address. It is valid for one hour.

{url}

If you did not sign up for OpenInvites, you can ignore this message.

resetPassword.subject: Reset your OpenInvites password
resetPassword.body:
Hi {name},

Open the link below to choose a new password. It is valid for one hour.

{url}

If you did not ask for this, you can ignore this message and your password stays as it is.

hostInvitation.subject: Your host invitation for OpenInvites
hostInvitation.body:
Hello,

Here is your host invitation for OpenInvites. Open the link below to create your host account and start making event pages.

{url}

The link works for one account and expires in {days} days. If you were not expecting this, you can ignore this message.
